component.name: StreamLight
component.summary: Gamepad-first game streaming client with host companion integration

description.p: StreamLight is a gamepad-first game streaming client for local network streaming, forked from Moonlight with enhanced host-side companion integration (StreamTweak).

ul.li: Gamepad-first navigation and customizable hotkey shortcuts
Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan support
Integrated performance overlay and real-time stream settings management
Seamless host links, pairing, metrics, and Tailscale integration

description.p: StreamLight release with gamepad-first UI overhaul, last played tracking, and companion features.
